releaseNotes.content:
## Introduction

Config script for FrSky RB25 and RB25S.

## Enhancement

- Added and updated relevant configuration items to support the RB25(S) firmware update version 3.0.5.
- Added the option to enable/disable switching ability between different Gyro banks.

## Fixes

- Fixed the issue of calibration failure.

## V2.1.8

- Added missing translation string.

## V2.1.9

- Isolate script globals so they are not overwritten by other scripts.
- Fixed the backup and restore dialog text display issue.

## V2.1.10

- Improve display performance in light mode.

## V2.1.11

- Added back the missing basic configuration (Including Gyro mode and ADV config)

## V2.1.12

- Added missing gyro ON/OFF configuration
- Fixed an issue where device could not be configured when telemetry data was received from an external module.

If you are running Ethos 1.6.0 or later, you can find it in the Device Config menu.
